title: Wrong doors
body: The hallway is the eleventh-floor hallway, except the numbers run 1201, 1202, 1203. The carpet is the same carpet. The exit signs point at each other. Through the end window, the hoverlanes should be visible — instead there is a flat amber wash, like the city rendered its skybox too close and forgot to add distance.

outcome.text: 1207 is a records room. The door is unlocked. Smoke, faint, like a file that has been thinking about burning for a long time. The window in there shows the same amber wash, but thinner, as if the glass is tired.
